Rooms.Name: The End of the Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
The road bends sharply here to the west, travelling slowly upwards
towards a large mountain of ancient, obviously volcanic origin.  The
path to the south is straight and well travelled.  A small trail
leads north into magnificent rolling hills.

Exits.Description: The path leads westwards towards a large mountain.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path ends abruptly at a tiny cave.  It looks barely large
enough to fit into.  A faint breeze coming from the cave carries the scent
of flowers upon it.  How very odd!  You may enter the small cave to the
north, and the small path returns back into the woods to the east,
allowing you passage in that direction.  You may also venture into the
woods to the south, but they are too dense to allow further passage to the
west.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the dense forest.  The trees continue
in every direction, but the path cuts through them to the west and south.
The forest continues to the north and east, but passage to the north is
impeded by an enormous wall of thorns.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.  Through the trees to the
west, you spy a small path cutting through the forest.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The forest surounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home.  The foliage grows quite dense to the
north, impeding any further progress in that direction.  You can wander
through the woods in every other direction.  You spot a small path through
the trees to the east.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path makes its way through the dense woods, leading you into
places unknown.  Almost hidden by the trees, you see a large iron gate to
the east.  The path continues to the south, and the dense forest may be
entered to the west, however the foliage is impenetrable to the north,
making further progress in that direction impossible.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The beautiful forest surrounds you on every side.  To the north and
east you see a small path through the tall trees.  The forest continues to
the south, but it grows too dense to continue to the west.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path meanders through the forest on its north-south journey.
You can follow it through the woods, or enter the forest itself to the
east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The forest surrounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home. You can wander through the woods
to the north, east, and south.  Through the trees to the west, you spy a
small path cutting through the forest.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The lovely forest surrounds you in every direction.  The tall trees
gaze down at you as you wander through their home.  A small bird swoops
down from his tree-top dwelling, buzzing just past your head in an attempt
to frighten you away.  You may continue through the woods in any
direction.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The lovely forest surrounds you in every direction.  The tall trees    
gaze down at you as you wander through their home.  You hear tiny
footsteps behind you, but when you turn to see who is making them, you
only see the trees.  You may continue through the forest to the north,
east, south, or west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
As you wander through the woods, you get the sense that someone, or
something, is watching you!  Should you be afraid?  Only if you don't know
what sort of creatures live in these woods!  The trees continue in every
direction, and you notice a small path cutting through them to the south
and east.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path leads through the woods to the north and south.  Through
the tall trees, you see what appears to be a large wall to the east.  You
may enter the forest to the west, or continue along the path to the north
or south.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
Wandering through the woods, you hear the sounds of the forest
creatures all around you.  The trees continue in every direction, but they
become too dense to pass any further to the west.  Through the trees, you
can see a small path making its way through the forest to the east.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path meanders through the forest on its north-south journey.
You can follow it through the woods, or enter the forest itself to the
east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The forest surrounds you on all sides.  The tall trees gaze down at you
as you wander through their home. You can wander through the woods
to the north, east, and south.  Through the trees to the west, you spy a
small path cutting through the forest.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
You can feel the eyes of the forest creatures upon you as you wander
through their home.  The trees continue to the north, west, and south, and
to the east you can see a small path wandering through the woods.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path wanders through the forest to the south and east.
You can hear birds chirping in the trees lining the path as you wander
through the forest.  The forest continues to the north and west, allowing
you to leave the path and wander there.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path continues through the woods to the east and west.  The
trees that line the path are apparently home to many small creatures, as
you can feel their eyes watching you as you wander through their home.
You may enter the forest itself to the north and south, or stay on the
path by following it east or west.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path leads through the woods to the north and west.  Through
the tall trees, you see what appears to be a large wall to the east.  You
may enter the forest to the south, or follow the path to the north or
west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The forest continues in every direction, but it is too dense to pass to
the south or west.  Through the trees you can see a small path making its
way through the woods to the east.  You may also continue through the
woods to the north.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path wanders through the forest to the north and south.  The
trees that line the path gaze down at you as you make your way through
their home.  You may continue along the path to the north and south, or
wander into the woods to the east or west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The trees of the forest continue their domain in every direction.
Through the branches, you see a small path making its way through the
woods to the west and south.  As you wander through his home, a small bird
chirps angrily at you!

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
Wandering through the woods you can sense the eyes of the forest
creatures upon you.  They seem harmless enough, but you can never tell
what the trees may hide.  The woods continue to the north and west, and to
the south and east you see a small path making its way through the forest.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path winds through the dense forest, allowing you to follow
its journey.  The path continues to the north and south, and you can
wander through the trees to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The dense foliage surrounds you in every direction.  The forest becomes
impossible to pass through to the south, but you may move in any other
direction.  Through the trees, you notice a small path making its way
through the forest to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Woods
Rooms.Description:
The dense forest surrounds you on every side.  Through the tall trees,
you notice what appears to be a wall to the east.  To the west and south
is more forest, but the thick foliage keeps you from moving any further
south.  You can see a small path cutting through the forest to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: A Split in the Path
Rooms.Description:
The small path splits here, leading off through the forest to the
north, east and south.  The trees grow quite dense along the path, forcing
you to stay on it.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The path wanders through the woods to the east and west here.  The tall
trees gaze down at you as you follow the path through their home.  The
forest is too dense to travel further south, but it is passable to the
north.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The path wanders through the woods to the east and west here.  The tall
trees gaze down at you as you follow the path through their home.  The
forest is too dense to travel further south, but it is passable to the
north.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path bends sharply as it meets a dense growth of trees to the
east.  Through the trees, you can barely see a large wall.  The dense
forest continues to the south, but you wouldn't be able to make your way
through the underbrush in that direction.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path winds through the forest to the north and south.  The
trees lining the path grow quite close together, forcing you to stay on
the path.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path continues through the woods to the east and south.  The
forest lining the path is too dense to travel in any other direction.  As
you wander along the path, you can hear birds chirping, and a small
creature hastily scurries away at your approach somewhere in the trees.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path winds through the forest to the north and west.  The
trees lining the path grow quite close together, forcing you to stay on
the path.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many 
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the forest on its north-south
journey.  The trees grow very close together along the path, making it
impossible to wander into the woods.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the forest on its north-south 
journey.  The trees grow very close together along the path, making it    
impossible to wander into the woods.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
This wide road cuts through a large forest on its way north and south.
To the east and west, the forest is so dense that it is impenetrable.  The
wide dirt road has seen much use, and you may follow it like so many
others have on your way north or south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Path through the Woods
Rooms.Description:
The small path leads you through the forest on its north-south 
journey.  The trees grow very close together along the path, making it    
impossible to wander into the woods.  To the south, you see that the path
leads toward a narrow path at the edge of the woods.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
The wide road cuts through the northern lands on its way to places
unknown.  To the east, a narrow road branches off of this one.  It takes a
path along the southern edge of a great forest.  To the north, the road
continues on its way through a dense forest.  A wide clay road branches off
to the west, leading towards a large city.  The northern road also
continues to the south, towards another large city.

Rooms.Name: A Narrow Road
Rooms.Description:
The narrow road is the northern border of a large rolling plain.  To
the north of the road is a large forest, filled with all sorts of
wildlife.  The narrow road seems to have been built to accomodate the
passage of wagons judging from the twin ruts that have been cut into it
over time.  The road continues to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: A Narrow Road
Rooms.Description:
The narrow road is the northern border of a large rolling plain.  To   
the north of the road is a large forest, filled with all sorts of 
wildlife.  The narrow road seems to have been built to accomodate the 
passage of wagons judging from the twin ruts that have been cut into it   
over time.  The road continues to the east and west.

Rooms.Description:
The narrow road is the northern border of a large rolling plain.  To

Rooms.Name: A Narrow Road
Rooms.Description:
The narrow road is the northern border of a large rolling plain.  To
the north of the road is a large forest, filled with all sorts of
wildlife.  The narrow road seems to have been built to accomodate the
passage of wagons judging from the twin ruts that have been cut into it
over time.  The road continues to the east, leading into a small village
at the edge of the forest.  To the north, a small path branches off this
narrow road.  The road also continues back along the edge of the plains to
the west.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
The rolling plains extend east for quite some distance, eventually
leading into hills and mountains.  To the west is a large, dark forest.
The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,
the road leads towards a large city.

Rooms.Name: The Northern Road
Rooms.Description:
The rolling plains extend east for quite some distance, eventually
leading into hills and mountains.  To the west is a large, dark forest.
The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,
the road leads towards a large city.

The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,

The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,

Rooms.Description:

leading into hills and mountains.  To the west is a large, dark forest.   
The road continues towards the north, into places unknown.  To the south,

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
The small trail winds its way through the hills as it leaves the
Northern Road.  In the distance to the north, you see the snowcapped
peaks of a mountain range.  The path continues to the north, and
leads to the Northern Road to the south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
The small trail follows the terrain of the rolling hills.  As the
hills crest and fall, so does the trail.  The air is much cooler as
you progress towards the north, closer to the snowapped peaks you can
see in the distance.  The trail continues through the hills to the
north and south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
The small trail follows the terrain of the rolling hills.  As the
hills crest and fall, so does the trail.  The air is much cooler as
you progress towards the north, closer to the snowapped peaks you can
see in the distance.  The trail continues through the hills to the
north and south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
As the trail continues through the hills, the terrain becomes
considerably more treacherous.  The rolling hills have become more
steep as they approach the still-distant mountains.  The trail
continues through the hills to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
As the trail continues through the hills, the terrain becomes 
considerably more treacherous.  The rolling hills have become more   
steep as they approach the still-distant mountains.  The trail 
continues through the hills to the north and south.

Rooms.Name: A Small Trail Through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
The trail winds its way through the hills, apparently heading
towards the snowcapped mountains in the not-so-distant north.  The
cool, crisp air is invigorating!  The trail turns to the east,
apparently to avoid a large boulder that has been left here by the
forces of nature.  It also heads south, into more gently rolling
hills.

Rooms.Name: A Winding Trail Through the Hills
Rooms.Description:
As the trail winds its way through the increasingly steep hills,
you begin to notice that the air is much more thin.  Perhaps the
altitude is to blame.  Upon reaching the crest of one particularly
large hill, you realize that you can see for miles in every distance.
To the north you see the snowcapped peaks of a large mountain range.
The range appears to curve southwards along the east and west ends,
forming a sort of basin within which these hills reside. A steep
incline leads down and north into what appears to be a boulder
field.  To the south, the hills roll gently, and past them is a large
forest.  The trail continues through the hills to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
Rooms.Description:
Boulders are strewn about everywhere, by the forces of nature...
or perhaps they have been placed here intentionally.  The boulder
field continues to the north and east, but becomes too treacherous to
pass to the west.  A short climb to the south would take you to a
small trail that winds its way through the hills in that direction.

Rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
Rooms.Description:
Large boulders have been thrown haphazardly about, making it
rather difficult to maneuver through this terrain.  The boulder field
continues to the north, towards a large mountain range, and south
towards the hills.

Rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
Rooms.Description:
As the boulder field approaches the mountains, you notice that a
small pass cuts through the range not far to the north.  Perhaps if
you are able to make your way through this field, access to the other
side of the range would be attainable.  The large boulders make your
journey difficult, but a somewhat clear path leads to the north and
south.

Rooms.Name: Approaching the Mountain Pass
Rooms.Description:
As you reach the base of the mountain range, you see that there is
indeed a pass through it.  However, it has been quite blocked by a
recent landslide.  Passage through the rubble is quite impossible to
the north, but a somewhat clear path leads into a boulder field to
the south.

Rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
Rooms.Description:
Enormous boulders litter the field, making it very difficult to
make your way through.  Passage to the north and south is blocked by
particularly large boulders.  Their placement seems too precise to be
natural, as if the "path" you are on was made intentionally.  While 
treacherous, the boulder field continues to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
Rooms.Description:
The large boulders that line the field keep you on an east-west
path as you venture through the rocky terrain.  Past the boulders to
the north, you can see a large mountain range, meeting the sky with
its snowcapped peaks.

Rooms.Name: The Boulder Field
Rooms.Description:
Large boulders line a sort of path through the field.  They guide
you on a north and west journey, further into the field.  A short
distance to the north, the path appears to end abruptly at a large
boulder, but you may continue through the field to the west.

Mobs.Name: bouncy ferret male m500
Mobs.LongDescription: The bouncy male ferret races through the grasses.
Mobs.Description:
This small bundle of fur loves racing through the high grasses.
Although small, he is fierce and can easily kill animals several times
his size.  He is sly and quick, and not an animal you want to harass!

Mobs.Name: general Roman procession leader m501
Mobs.LongDescription: The Roman general follows his triumphal procession into Rome.
Mobs.Description:
Wearing the laurel wreath of the successful Roman general, Fobos
Maximilius follows his successful army back to Rome.  They bring with
them treasures from the mighty civilizations and barbaric tribes they
have conquered.  The general ponders the effect his triumph may have on
his political career.  Perhaps he should stage a coup.

Mobs.Name: albino female ferret snow white m503
Mobs.LongDescription: The pure white ferret is too busy playing ferret games to notice you.
Mobs.Description:
Often just a streak of white, racing up a tree or across the road in
front of you (startling the horses), this ferret spends her days
frolicking in the grass.  She is so beautiful, so soft and sleek, that
she is frequently fed by passersby.  She is an animal worthy of being a
pet to an emperor.

Mobs.Name: centurion Roman soldier leader m504
Mobs.LongDescription: The Roman centurion commands his 100 soldiers with a will of iron.
Mobs.Description:
Wearing a bronze helmet topped with bright red feathers, the Roman
centurion struts at the head of his 100 man command.  The Roman army
was, as always, successful, and the centurion is mentally spending the
bonus he will receive.  He is a tall man, well favored, with a long
straight nose.  His skin is well-tanned and firm, though it bears many
scars.

Mobs.Name: slave captive gallic Gaul m508
Mobs.LongDescription: The Gallic captive, now a slave to the Romans, glares haughtily at you.
Mobs.Description:
He was a great and fierce fighter, but he was captured and now will be
a great and proud slave.  His body still retains the remnants of blue
paint, which evidently was not enough to frighten off the Roman armies.
His amulet of herbs and unmentionables, worn about his neck, were also
not enough to protect him from capture.

Mobs.Name: fairy floating m509
Mobs.LongDescription: Lightly floating on a breeze, the fairy flies north to see Titania.
Mobs.Description:
The delicate fairy, dressed in gossamer thin fabric, is enjoying the
feel of the light breeze on his skin.  His delicate pale features and
light boned body make him appear frail, but his magic makes him
fearsomely strong.

Mobs.Name: orc black huge captive prisoner m510
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge Black Orc shuffles along, a captive of war in chains.
Mobs.Description:
During a trip through the Morian caves, in search of the fabled
treasures of the ancient elven city of Illir, the Roman army decimated
the population of Orcs, deeming them too stupid to bother to bring
back.  They did spare a few, just for the curiosity sake.

Mobs.Name: elf woodelf wood m512
Mobs.LongDescription: The little wood elf is heading off for a lark in Tynstri to the east.
Mobs.Description:
The merry little elf has skin the color of oak bark on a warm summer
afternoon.  He is off to visit some distant cousins, who live in the
woods northeast of Tynstri.  With his dark green tunic he easily blends
into the woods surrounding the road.  He slips into the woods, hiding
when the path becomes busy.

Mobs.Name: rabbit longears mr jackrabbit m513
Mobs.LongDescription: Mr. Longears is off to visit his jackrabbit friends in the forest.
Mobs.Description:
Mr. Longears is a very large rabbit, with long, strong hind legs and
feet and ears that stretch high above his head.  As he hops along, his
legs pound the earth with a heavy thud, and he practically flies
through the grass.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 hop;%5 em wiggles his rabbit nose, sniffing the air

Mobs.Name: burnt umber ghost dragon m514
Mobs.LongDescription: The huge burnt umber ghost was once a graceful dragon.
Mobs.Description:
Why should ghosts always be a foggy white?  That's what this (former)
dragon thought.  She loved beautiful jewels while still alive, and this
is about the best she can do now that she is a dragon ghost.  Robbed of
her strength by death, she can still be a formidable opponent.

Mobs.Name: barbarian evil slave m515
Mobs.LongDescription: The evil barbarian is led in chains past you, a prize of war.
Mobs.Description:
A tall human ... perhaps all of 6.5' (about 2m.) ... with heavy bone
structure and well defined musculature, the captive will undoubtedly
sell for a high price at the slave market.  His unshaven chin juts out
with pride, and his shoulders remain square, his back straight.  He is
aware of his worth and uncowed by his status.

Mobs.Name: warrior elephant roman m516
Mobs.LongDescription: Huge elephants brought back from a foreign campaign pound along.
Mobs.Description:
The pachyderm packs a whallop with his trunk, although he has not been
used for fighting.  Originally brought over from Africa by Hannibal,
who wanted to "surprise" the Romans one winter, these Romans are
delighted to bring them back as a prize to Rome.  They can carry
literally tons of treasure brought back from the wars.

Mobs.Name: hedgehog little m517
Mobs.LongDescription: The little hedgehog has rolled up into a spiny ball.
Mobs.Description:
The little hedgehog wishes to be left alone to sleep (if the sun is
shining) or roam around and rid the earth of worms, beetles and slugs,
surely a noble occupation!  This one is aware of your interest, and has
rolled himself into a little ball of sharp spines that say, "Don't
touch!"

Mobs.Name: sleepy bat hanging m518
Mobs.LongDescription: The sleepy bat is hanging from the tree branch, hoping he's invisible.
Mobs.Description:
This bat tends to think of the Romans as a race of vampires.  He and
his brethren, a small band of fruit bats, are killed by the romans and
the bodies drained of blood.  The blood is sold to the Roman shops
which help keep the citizens beautiful.

Mobs.Name: gnome gnomish scientist psci psi pscientist m519
Mobs.LongDescription: The #ggnomish#Y pscientist checks you carefully for signs of dragoness.
Mobs.Description:
He has heard rumors that sometimes dragons masquerade as other life
forms, and he is hot on the trail of some field research on the
subject.
Obviously, he has ignored the effect the dragons' hot breath might have
on his slightly hairy pointed ears.

Mobs.Name: ratman roman warrior soldier ratsoldier m520
Mobs.LongDescription: The Ratman Ratsoldier looks fierce despite his long twitching tail.
Mobs.Description:
As long as you are a land owning citizen, you may sign up for a 20 year
stretch in the Roman army.  Although it is a hard life (especially for
a rat), the promise of glory and a regular salary are hard to resist.

Mobs.Name: elf ranger m521
Mobs.LongDescription: The elf ranger watches you warily.
Mobs.Description:
The elf is new to his ranger job, and he takes it quite seriously.  He
is worried about the tramping of the Roman soldiers through this woods,
although as yet they have not discovered the path to the deep forest.
He fears he will soon have to do battle with them.

Mobs.Name: elf scout m522
Mobs.LongDescription: The elf scout looks for signs of danger approaching Tynstri.
Mobs.Description:
This small woodland elf is training hard, hoping one day to become a
mighty ranger.  Her hair is a deep green and quite short.  She is tiny,
but wiry, and her dusky brown skin helps her blend in.  She is ever
watchful for danger, although she is unsure what form it will take.
Could those enormous footprints, for example, be from some large
elf-predator?

Mobs.Name: Peter Rabbit m523
Mobs.LongDescription: Peter looks about curiously, wondering where the elves grow cabbages.
Mobs.Description:
A bit away from his original home, nevertheless Peter Rabbit still
loves carrots and cabbages, and the elves have a hard time keeping him
away
from their greens.  He is often to be seen hopping through the woods in
his blue waistcoat.

Mobs.Name: Benjamin Bunny m524
Mobs.LongDescription: Benjamin is a handsome little rabbit with white fur and pink ears.
Mobs.Description:
Benjamin often accompanies Peter on adventures in the forest.  Today
they are finding many little tricks to play on the elves.  Together
they can pound their hind feet into deep depressions in the earth, so
watchful elves believe there are LARGE MONSTERS in their forest!

Mobs.Name: cat striped skunk m525
Mobs.LongDescription: The black cat has a strange white stripe down his back.
Mobs.Description:
Pepe LePew would love this little stinker.  The skunk is busy digging
through forest debris looking for good things to eat.  She is solid
black with a bright white stripe starting at her head and extending
through her tail.  She may be small, but she has a secret weapon that
forces even very large predators to back away.

Mobs.Name: Pepe LePew skunk m526
Mobs.LongDescription: This skunk ain't no stinker.  He's a lover!
Mobs.Description:
Pepe is so busy looking for the skunk of his dreams that he may not
notice you.  Be sure not to frighten him, because the results would be
... alarming!

Mobs.Name: Mrs T Tiggywinkle Hedgehog m527
Mobs.LongDescription: Mrs Tiggywinkle is full of grandmotherly advice for you.
Mobs.Description:
Mrs T has tiny pink feet and a soft black nose.  Her back is covered
with long sharp spikes, and she is apt to roll up into a ball of spikes
when she is frightened.  Her belly is covered with soft white fur.
Mrs. T is very small, but very well armored.

Mobs.Name: duck jemima puddle puddle-duck m528
Mobs.LongDescription: Jemima Puddle-Duck waddles happily through forest streams and ponds.
Mobs.Description:
That's what ducks do best, after all!  Swimming in the little lakes and
ponds is something Jemima learned to do very early in life, and she is
quite good at it.

Mobs.Name: fairy apprentice mage m529
Mobs.LongDescription: A young fairy holds tightly to a short stick that seems to glow.
Mobs.Description:
The fairy is out exploring the woods for the first time, experimenting
with a wand he discovered in a workshop.  A very tiny mage with
gossamer wings that beat rapidly, his magic makes him more powerful than
a human
many times his size.

Mobs.Name: gnome old cloth merchant m530
Mobs.LongDescription: The old gnome leads a donkey laden with bolts of wool.
Mobs.Description:
Bringing heavy bolts of wool woven from Stanneg sheep, the cloth
merchant hopes to trade for some fairy cloth, should he be lucky enough
to discover the fairy home.

Mobs.Name: tinker m531
Mobs.LongDescription: The tinker easily carries his huge pack on his massive back.
Mobs.Description:
"Wandering from village to village, that's the life for me!"  A man of
enormous strength and cleverness, the tinker carries the tools of his
trade on his back.  Quick to fix, that's the tinker.

Mobs.Name: druid captive m532
Mobs.LongDescription: In his earth colored robes, the druid walks in harmony with the forest.
Mobs.Description:
Captured in Gaul, the Romans noted the druid's remarkable healing
abilities.  He will undoubtedly become the physician for some patrician
unable to afford a Greek slave.  He is tall, lean and pale, with long
brown hair tied neatly at his neck with a leather thong.

Mobs.Name: mouse m533
Mobs.LongDescription: The frightened mouse scurries off to hide from you.
Mobs.Description:
Long black whiskers twitching as he glares at you from his beady little
mouse eyes, the mouse is panicking, attempting to flee ... from YOU!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 em twitches nervously.;%2 twitch;%2em 's whiskers tremble violently.

Mobs.Name: fox sly red m534
Mobs.LongDescription: The sly red fox curls up in the shade, tail tucked neatly around him.
Mobs.Description:
The fox may be the picture of innocence and foxy beauty where he lies
beneath the tree, but he is a very clever fellow.  Hiding his razor
sharp teeth in an appearance of sleep is just one of his many tricks.

Mobs.Name: gnome picnic boy m535
Mobs.LongDescription: The boy gnome carries the heavy basket, looking for a good picnic spot.
Mobs.Description:
The boy gnome wonders what his Midgaardian girl friend could possibly
have packed in the basket, it is so heavy.  It feels like rocks!  The
little gnome hopes they will find a nice place for a picnic very soon!

Mobs.Name: girl picnic m536
Mobs.LongDescription: The Midgaard girl warily fingers her dagger as she looks about her.
Mobs.Description:
She has never seen so many trees in her life.  They have a presence of
their own - a "beingness", and she is unsure whether it is benign or
evil.  She leans a bit closer to her gnome and wonders if she should
help with the heavy basket.  She has packed some rocks to hold down the
blanket.

Mobs.Name: changeling baby m537
Mobs.LongDescription: Apparently someone has abandoned a sweet little baby.
Mobs.Description:
But Beware!  This softly crying babe is a changeling.  He will become a
small demon with a raging temper when disturbed.

Mobs.Name: girl red riding hood ridinghood m538
Mobs.LongDescription: The little girl in a bright red hooded cape carries a heavy basket.
Mobs.Description:
Two long dark pigtails trail out from under the cherry red hood that
keeps the child's head warm.  Bright blue eyes and an eager smile give
her a very elfin charm, although she is undoubtedly human.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 say do you know the way to Grandmother's house?;%1 say Have you seen
my pet wolf?

Mobs.Name: owl m539
Mobs.LongDescription: The horny owl eyes the mice hungrily.
Mobs.Description:
You are glad it's the mice and not you that those big golden eyes are
staring at!  The sharp beak and long talons look like they could do a
lot of damage.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 yell C'mere little mousey!  I have a nice surprise for you!

Mobs.Name: sparrow m540
Mobs.LongDescription: The gray-brown sparrow is looking for yummy worms and seeds.
Mobs.Description:
The tiny bird hops along in the short grass looking for good things to
eat.  It has a small, sharp beak and short, delicate claws, and doesn't
look like it could hurt anything bigger than a worm.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 em chirps cheerfully.;%2 emote pecks away at the dirt, trying to
unearth a worm.

Mobs.Name: worm red m541
Mobs.LongDescription: The long, glistening red worm looks like bird food.
Mobs.Description:
He took a wrong turn in one of the many tunnels underground and now,
alas, he is destined to be breakfast for some sparrow or bait for some
fish.  He is your garden variety long red worm, not too bright.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 emote heads down into the dirt and knocks himself out on a rock.

Mobs.Name: slug m542
Mobs.LongDescription: The slug slimes his way along the underside of a leaf.
Mobs.Description:
Carrying a little house around with him is a lot of work.  The slug
munches the tender leaves of young plants and wonders how long til he
has to build something a little larger.

Mobs.Name: sly pinworm m543
Mobs.LongDescription: #r"DESTRUCTION FROM WITHIN!!" shouts the lowly pinworm.#N
Mobs.Description:
The sly pinworm is waiting for his chance to work his way into your
body and cause massive destruction! ... or at least some itching,
discomfort, and massive barfiness.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 say C'mon, baby! Let me worm my way into your heart!

Mobs.Name: halfling roman soldier m544
Mobs.LongDescription: The halfling looks small, but his heart is as brave as any Roman's.
Mobs.Description:
This halfling is small and far from the land of his grandparent's birth,
but he is a Roman citizen-soldier and very proud of it.  His parents,
captured in a raid, were able to buy their freedom from their small
tobacco shop.

Mobs.Name: gnome roman soldier m544
Mobs.LongDescription: The gnomish soldier is in charge of building roads across ravines.
Mobs.Description:
This gnome was something of a washout in terms of carrying around 3 days
worth of equipment on his back, but he is a positive genius when it
comes to building bridges and designing campsites.  He is small and
getting a trifle old for the life of a soldier.

Objects.Name: breast plate
Objects.Description: A breast plate is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: shield
Objects.Description: A small wooden shield is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: bronze breast plate
Objects.Description: A bronze breast plate is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: gauntlets bronze
Objects.Description: A pair of bronze gauntlets is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: helmet bronze
Objects.Description: A bronze helmet is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: leggings bronze
Objects.Description: A pair of bronze leggings is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: sleeves bronze
Objects.Description: A pair of bronze sleeves is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: bronze belt romeobj
Objects.Description: This bronze belt will probably be overlooked since it is invisible.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Hammered from bronze by dwarven metalsmiths, this belt is adequate
protection for a new soldier.  Being invisible, it may lure an enemy to
strike where it appears the soldier is unprotected.  Very cunning.
